mentions.heading: Cyclical and competitive vehicle demand amid macroeconomic conditions
mentions.detail: Auto sales cyclical; rising interest rates may cause consumers to cut spending on vehicles
mentions.quote: Rising interest rates may lead to consumers to increasingly pull back spending, including on our products, which may harm our demand, business and operating results.

mentions.heading: Robotaxi service success depends on adoption of autonomous driving
mentions.detail: Robotaxi launched June 2025; plans to mass produce Cybercab; depends on consumer acceptance of autonomous driving
mentions.quote: Upon launching our Robotaxi service in June 2025, we also entered into the autonomous ride-hailing service market, and have plans to mass produce Cybercab, a purpose-built Robotaxi product.

mentions.heading: We face strong competition for our products and services from a growing list of established and new competitors.
mentions.detail: Many entrants in EV, hybrid and self-driving markets; domestic-assembly incentives may favour competitors
mentions.quote: In addition, certain government and economic incentives which provide benefits to manufacturers who assemble domestically or have local suppliers, may provide a greater benefit to our competitors, which could negatively impact our profitability.

drivers.name: electric and other alternative fuel vehicles

mentions.heading: Competition in energy generation and storage business
mentions.detail: Competition from utilities; lower electricity prices could reduce product appeal and raise customer defaults
mentions.quote: In addition, decreases in the retail or wholesale prices of electricity from utilities or other renewable energy sources could make our products less attractive to customers and lead to an increased rate of customer defaults.

mentions.heading: Growth of our business is also dependent upon our ability to develop and commercialize Bots, including Optimus
mentions.detail: Optimus humanoid robots not yet commercialized; significant cash investment with uncertain demand
mentions.quote: While this development requires significant cash investments and management resources, there is no guarantee this business will be successful. We have yet to commercialize Bots and cannot predict how demand for Bots will develop, either from commercial or consumer applications.

mentions.heading: Issues with lithium-ion cells or components manufactured at our Gigafactories
mentions.detail: Vehicle and storage growth depends on lithium-ion cell, module, pack and drive unit production at Gigafactories
mentions.quote: Our plan to grow the volume and profitability of our vehicles and energy storage products depends on significant lithium-ion battery cell production.
